_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are calibrated ~5pp UNDER the measured rates (same convention as the #36 coverage floor; ~2.6pp == 1 in-scope case at n=38, ~3.6pp == 1 out-of-scope case at n=28, leaving temperature=0 re-capture jitter room). Measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version 99f0d256c7a12799, 2026-06-12, 66 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (38/38), T4_answer_correct 0.89 (34/38), out_of_scope_honest 0.93 (26/28 — the 2 misses are the adversarial count-routing leaks adv-injection-huge-window / adv-unicode-rtl-noise, targeted by the few-shot worked-examples iteration). min_fixtures == bank size (66 since bank_version 2); new cases are captured on their PR branch before merge, so the committed set stays uniform. Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
